mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_stage n WHERE n.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND n.project_id = p.id AND n.deleted = b'0' AND n.status NOT IN ('DONE','CLOSED','TERMINATED','CANCELLED') AND (n.plan_end_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}) OR n.acceptance_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt})))

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_task n WHERE n.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND n.project_id = p.id AND n.deleted = b'0' AND n.status NOT IN ('DONE','CLOSED','TERMINATED','CANCELLED') AND (n.plan_end_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}) OR n.acceptance_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt})))
mapper.select: SELECT project_id, 'STAGE' AS node_kind, id AS node_id, name AS node_name, plan_end_time, acceptance_time, NULL AS completed_at, IFNULL(plan_end_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}), 0) AS work_overdue, IFNULL(acceptance_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}), 0) AS acceptance_overdue FROM proj_project_stage WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND status NOT IN ('DONE','CLOSED','TERMINATED','CANCELLED') AND (plan_end_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}) OR acceptance_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt})) AND UNION ALL SELECT project_id, 'TASK', id, name, plan_end_time, acceptance_time, NULL, IFNULL(plan_end_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}), 0), IFNULL(acceptance_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}), 0) FROM proj_project_task WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND status NOT IN ('DONE','CLOSED','TERMINATED','CANCELLED') AND (plan_end_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt}) OR acceptance_time < DATE(#{query.effectiveAt})) AND UNION ALL SELECT project_id, node_kind, node_id, node_name, plan_end_time, acceptance_time, completed_at, work_overdue, acceptance_overdue FROM proj_node_overdue_completion WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND (work_overdue = b'1' OR acceptance_overdue = b'1') AND ORDER BY project_id, completed_at, node_kind, node_id
